title: Smaller
text: Smaller. This is not what I expected it to be this is way smaller than what I thought.I'm actually really upset because I would have bought another sweeper if I woulda knew this was so tiny.and the handle that's on the slipper is literally hanging on by a little bit of glue I'm really upset about this.
